page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m16-vws.5xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.vgn6i-vws family. It is equipped with 20 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 10 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. System memory consists of 92.0 GB of RAM, translating to 4.6 GB of memory per core. This instance features a bundled NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM, while local storage is not included. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1105.39 and a Geekbench single-core score of 929.0, both placing in the lower percentiles. Conversely, multi-core operations achieve average performance levels, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 14732.17 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 6611.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks also demonstrate average performance, delivering 81.06 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 49.22 GB/sec for large block write operations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced allocation of dedicated CPU resources and memory paired with a professional-grade GPU, making it suitable for workloads that can leverage GPU acceleration without requiring top-tier single-core CPU speeds. Tradeoffs include the lack of local storage and lower single-threaded processing efficiency. The hardware profile is well-suited for virtual workstations, multi-threaded database operations, 3D ray tracing, image processing, and static web serving.
